an10.4:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an10.4:1.2: Dussīlassa āvuso sīlavipannassa hatupaniso hoti avippaṭisāro,
an10.4:1.3: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
an10.4:1.5: Seyyathā pi āvuso rukkho sākhāpalāsavipanno, tassa papaṭikā pi na pāripūriṃ gacchati, taco pi pheggu pi sāro pi na pāripūriṃ gacchati,
an10.4:1.6: evam eva kho āvuso dussīlassa sīlavipannassa hatupaniso hoti avippaṭisāro,
an10.4:1.7: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
an10.4:2.1: Sīlavato āvuso sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti avippaṭisāro,
an10.4:2.2: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
an10.4:2.4: Seyyathā pi āvuso rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno, tassa papaṭikā pi pāripūriṃ gacchati, taco pi pheggu pi sāro pi pāripūriṃ gacchati,
an10.4:2.5: evam eva kho āvuso sīlavato sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti avippaṭisāro,
an10.4:2.6: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
